strings.text: The first two trip events are on the school's Global Education calendar; the other deadlines come from the 2027 trip pages and are not on the calendar yet. Global trips are for Middle and Upper School students; the GSD events are for Upper School students in the program, who typically begin it in 9th grade. The three published 2027 trips are Upper School only, for students in grades 9–11 when they register. A nonrefundable deposit is due at registration, and the balance can be paid in full or in two installments. Japan and Iceland take 10 to 16 students and France 8 to 14, with a waitlist after that.
